claims.claim: Declares src/index.ts as the package's only Pi extension surface.
Registers ask_user_question as a model-callable tool and describes clarification, preference, and implementation-decision uses.
Bounds each call to one through four questions and each question to two through four options, with a multi-select flag.
Rejects duplicate question text and duplicate option labels before opening the UI.
Disables the tool for the session and returns a cancelled error result when no interactive UI is present.
Adds a typed-answer row and a separate submit tab to the interactive component.
Renders multi-select options as checkboxes and preserves typed input as an additional answer choice.
Combines selected labels in option order and appends typed input for a multi-select answer.
